title: When the Oath Turns
author: Emrys Thackeray
blurb: Coral Dunmore, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
